body: When training Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models with expert parallelism, all-to-all token dispatch and combine collectives can consume a substantial fraction of end-to-end training time. In this work, we study communication-efficient MoE models (CE-MoE), in which we adopt a heterogeneous layer pattern that decouples token-mixing and channel-mixing depth. Compared to conventional models which interleave MoE layers after each token-mixing layer (e.g., attention, Mamba-2), CE-MoE models concentrate expert capacity in a select few routed MoE layers, while maintaining depth by adding additional token-mixing and dense-FFN layers. Across a scaling ladder from 2B to 31.5B total parameters, under matched total and activated parameters, CE-MoE models consistently reduce training cost while matching validation loss and downstream benchmarks with full-MoE baselines. At the 31.5B scale, CE-MoE uses 33.3\% fewer GPU-hours while improving average downstream score and inference throughput.
summaryZh: 训练混合专家（MoE）大语言模型时，专家并行中的all-to-all分发和收集操作往往会消耗大量训练时间。为此，本文研究了通信高效的CE-MoE模型，采用异构层模式解耦token混合与通道混合深度。在2B到31.5B的规模测试中，CE-MoE在保持验证损失和下游基准性能的同时，将训练GPU小时数减少了33.3%，并提升了推理吞吐量。

glossary.explanationZh: 混合专家模型架构，通过稀疏激活部分网络参数来大幅提升模型容量与计算效率。
专家并行，一种将MoE的不同专家层分布到不同计算设备上的并行训练策略。
在MoE中将各个token路由并分发到对应专家节点上的通信过程。
推理吞吐量，衡量模型在单位时间内处理请求或生成token数量的指标。
